mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.user_id,a.certificate_id,a.holder_name_encrypted,a.number_type,a.number_encrypted,a.number_hash,a.obtained_on,a.attachment_id,a.auxiliary_id,a.note,a.revision,a.auto_result,a.auto_details,a.official_result,a.status,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name certificate_name FROM certificate_application a JOIN certificate c ON c.id=a.certificate_id WHERE a.id=#{id}

SELECT id,user_id,certificate_id,holder_name_encrypted,number_type,number_encrypted,number_hash,obtained_on,attachment_id,auxiliary_id,note,revision,auto_result,auto_details,official_result,status,created_at,updated_at FROM certificate_application WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM certificate_application WHERE number_hash=#{hash} AND id!=#{id} AND status NOT IN ('REJECTED','REVOKED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_revision SELECT id,revision,to_jsonb(a),now() FROM certificate_application a WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate_application SET certificate_id=#{certificateId},holder_name_encrypted=#{holder},number_type=#{numberType},number_encrypted=#{number},number_hash=#{hash},obtained_on=#{obtainedOn},attachment_id=#{attachmentId},auxiliary_id=#{auxiliaryId},note=#{note},auto_result=#{autoResult},auto_details=CAST(#{autoDetails,typeHandler=cn.zhijie.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler} AS jsonb),revision=revision+1,status='PENDING',official_result='UNVERIFIED',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,application_id,reviewer_id,result,official_source,evidence,ownership_evidence,created_at FROM verification_record WHERE application_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id,application_id,reviewer_id,action,reason,created_at FROM review_record WHERE application_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC
